why: The internal nodes are given in level order of a perfect binary tree, so node i has children 2i+1 and 2i+2 and the leaves follow them. Undo the distribution bottom-up: a splitting node's stream is left + right, a parallelising node's stream interleaves left and right.
hints: Think of the tree as an array heap. Where do the leaves sit, and which node is whose parent?
Work from the last internal node back to the root. Each node rebuilds its own stream from its two children's streams, inverting what it did.
Type 0: concatenate left then right. Type 1: put left at even positions and right at odd positions (left is the longer one if odd). Total work O(total values * depth).
pitfalls: Strip the -1 padding from each leaf row before using it.
For an odd stream the left child got the extra item in both node types; slicing with result[0::2] = left handles that.
Leaves are indices m..2m in heap order when there are m internal nodes.
